text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync: proposal to add per-prefix TTLs + a soft-demote window to reduce eviction thrash. Need alignment on eviction contract, rollout, and telemetry.

Alex Rivera: Sounds useful. Question: where to persist TTL? slab metadata or prefix descriptor?

Priya Kapoor: Put it on the prefix descriptor. Prefixs can span slabs and the descriptor already carries other per-prefix policy.

Samir Patel: Putting on descriptor means updates create writes. For frequent TTL changes (e.g., experiments) we could increase write amplification.

Maria Chen: Proposal: descriptors are immutable per epoch. TTL update = new epoch; reuse manifest CAS path so it piggybacks with other descriptor updates and avoids separate write path.

Ben Torres: Eviction score suggestion: score = hotness * decay(age, ttl) * tenant_weight. Decay should be monotonic and bounded to avoid flips.

Alex Rivera: Define decay carefully. ttl==null -> no decay. Choose sentinel for infinite TTL. Avoid divide-by-zero.

Priya Kapoor: Telemetry requests: per-tenant eviction rate, demote->evict transitions, score histogram, eviction latency histogram. We need these to tune tenant_weight and notify regressions.

Samir Patel: Rollout safety: feature flag to revert to legacy scoring. During canary prefer demote over evict if churn spikes.

Maria Chen: Proposed rollout: feature flag -> canary 1% -> monitor eviction_churn, demote_ratio, 99/99.9p tail latency for 24h -> ramp.

evict-bot: Deploy started: evict-ttl-softdemote v1 -> canary 1% at 2026-04-02T13:00Z

Ben Torres: Tests to add: unit tests for score math, fuzzing TTL extremes, chaos under high churn, integration replay with hotkey traces.

Alex Rivera: Implementation note: avoid slow math on hot path. Either table lookup or cheap approx. Example:

```
# cheap approximation to avoid exp on hot path
# decay(age, ttl) = 1 / (1 + age/ttl)  # cheap and monotonic
```

Priya Kapoor: API change: add optional `prefix_ttl` to prefix create/update. Default null -> legacy behavior (infinite TTL). Document semantics: value in seconds, 0 = immediate decay behavior? decide.

Samir Patel: Back-compat: absent prefix_ttl = legacy infinite. Ensure migration idempotent and safe for old clients. Also consider an admin override for per-tenant caps.

Maria Chen: Action items: Maria implement descriptor epoch & TTL, Alex build fast-approx table + perf microbench, Ben add sim harness + dashboards, Priya update API docs + examples, Samir write rollout runbook + flags. I'll open PRs and link here.

Alex Rivera: Please add perf metric: 95p CPU overhead per request and token cost delta when scoring changes. I'll review PRs.

Ben Torres: Alerting: create alert if eviction_churn increases > 15% during canary, and rollback if demote_ratio < configured threshold.

Maria Chen: Also prefer demote when eviction pressure > emergency threshold to avoid evict storms. We'll include that as a safety gate.

Priya Kapoor: Will draft docs and include curl examples for setting prefix_ttl.

Samir Patel: Note: consider capping tenant_weight per tenant to avoid noisy-neighbor amplification. We'll add that to follow-up.

evict-bot: Canary health snapshot (2h): eviction_churn +3%, demote_ratio stable, no critical alerts.

Maria Chen: OK closing for now. I'll post RFC follow-up with sample graphs and expected numbers. Thanks! :thumbsup:
